deals.travelWindow: Dec 2026 – Feb 2027, Allegiant nonstop; $44 one-way Jan 30, $46 Feb 7
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $44 (Jan 30), about $88–125 round trip; re-confirmed today as the cheapest BOS fare, and Everglades NP is ~1 h away.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable Las Olas and beach strip, a cheap water taxi, and easy day trips without a long drive.

highlights: Fort Lauderdale Beach promenade and Las Olas Boulevard
Water taxi along the Intracoastal and New River
Shark Valley tram and bike loop in Everglades NP
Hugh Taylor Birch State Park for a quiet beach-side walk
itinerary: Day 1 — Beach promenade, Las Olas lunch, water taxi at sunset
Day 2 — Everglades Shark Valley bike loop (rent a car or book a tour)
Day 3 — Hugh Taylor Birch State Park morning walk, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Water taxi and Brightline cover the core; a rental car only matters for the Everglades day.
guide.stayArea: Near Las Olas or the beach, walkable to food and the water taxi.

deals.travelWindow: Dec 13 onward, Allegiant nonstop; $58 one-way Dec 13
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $58 (Dec 13), about $116–160 round trip; Great Smoky Mountains NP is ~45 min away.
deals.soloWhy: Compact downtown, a free trolley, and Smokies day trips are simple with a rental car.

highlights: Great Smoky Mountains NP: Gatlinburg entrance and Laurel Falls
Market Square and Old City downtown
Urban Wilderness trails south of the river
itinerary: Day 1 — Market Square, Old City, Sunsphere sunset
Day 2 — Smokies: Laurel Falls and Newfound Gap road
Day 3 — Urban Wilderness hike, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable with a free trolley; rent a car for the Smokies.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square for walkable food and nightlife.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $63 (Nov 20), about $126–170 round trip; no national park nearby, but an easy solo city break.
deals.soloWhy: Small, safe downtown with free museums and connected skywalks for cold weather.

itinerary: Day 2 — Sculpture Park and Art Center
Day 3 — Botanical Garden, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable; a rideshare covers the Art Center.

itinerary: Day 3 — Lake Michigan day trip, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable; rent a car for the lakeshore.
